affine_saturation.fixed_error_generator: round(rho*K) coordinates forced to a clipping endpoint; outside-side signs are iid Rademacher and overshoots iid Uniform[0.25,1.25] grid steps
affine_saturation.reference: ||g_fix||^2 plus the active-coordinate same-grid Bernoulli expected energy

generator.directions: iid standard-Gaussian row directions, normalized rowwise
generator.imbalance_profile: randomly permuted j^{-alpha}, j=1,...,K, rescaled to unit RMS

methods.null_face: same reduction plus exhaustive reached-face enumeration; cost 2^|S| and not the polynomial walk
methods.walk_arbitrary: small-SVD null-space reduction plus nearest residual rounding; polynomial
methods.walk_ce: same reduction plus deterministic conditional-expectation residual rounding; polynomial

static.dataset: scikit-learn Digits, raw pixels divided by 16

metadata.calibration_subset_sampling: stratified without replacement within each subset

static.split: five deterministic stratified 60% fit / 20% calibration pool / 20% test splits
